content:
Rather than using a third-party client to send data directly to an OpenSearch Serverless collection,
you can use Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion. You conﬁgure your data producers to send data to
OpenSearch Ingestion, and it automatically delivers the data to the collection that you specify.
You can also conﬁgure OpenSearch Ingestion to transform your data before delivering it. For more
information, see Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion.
An OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline needs permission to write to an OpenSearch Serverless
collection that is conﬁgured as its sink. These permissions include the ability to describe the
collection and send HTTP requests to it. For instructions to use OpenSearch Ingestion to add data
to a collection, see the section called “Granting pipelines access to collections”.
To get started with OpenSearch Ingestion, see the section called “Tutorial: Ingest data into a
collection”.
